idempotent_differences.scope: Checks the matrix identities and signed telescoping used in the proof, not arbitrary homological fillings.

intersection_witness.scope: Abstract finite-rank descent; no pairwise Artin intersection theorem tested.

fixed_plane.scope: Homotopy and regular-fiber derivative only; mod-two degree is inspected analytically, not numerically certified.

capping.scope: Fixed explicit injections only; uniform constants for arbitrary injections use the source Morse argument.

stable_virtual_free.scope: Finite windows and finite quotients; no general Hopficity or ascending-torus finiteness theorem tested.

scope: Selected finite mechanisms; no embedding, Artin, group-equation or one-relator headline theorem is certified.
